## Controller 1.0.51 (82)
- **Device frames:** The Simulator panel shows each simulator inside its real device frame, drawn from Xcode's own artwork, for every iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch Xcode supports. Screens get their true corners and notches, and the iPhone Duo's frame turns with its inner screen when open. - **Apple Watch simulators:** The Simulator panel now lists watchOS simulators, with live screen, touches and swipes. Home presses the Digital Crown. Agent simulator tools still work with iOS simulators only. - **iPad simulators:** iPads no longer show sideways in the Simulator panel. - **Agents in the simulator:** An agent's simulator session no longer ends after a minute of thinking between steps. On iOS 27, agents can tap items on screens such as Settings → General that were wrongly treated as covered. Snapshots leave out the keyboard's individual keys and the previous screen after a full screen change, so agents read less noise. A keyboard or alert check with nothing to report no longer fails. - **Worked for:** A running turn on a thread that has used more than one account no longer shows an early "Worked for" label or treats a progress message as the final answer.

## Controller 1.0.51 (81)
- **Translations:** Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese now cover the Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch and Android apps, including accessibility labels, notifications and system permission prompts. Watch and Live Activity labels follow the language of the device showing them. Text written by agents and providers stays as written. A few of the newest labels are still in English. - **Composer tags:** A tagged item in your prompt now appears as a chip where the tag sits, matching the chips under the prompt. Copying text that contains a chip copies the tag. - **iOS Simulator:** Fold an iPhone Duo between Closed, Book, Open, Laptop and Tent from the panel's Fold menu, and agents can do the same with the new `simulator_fold` tool. The panel follows whichever screen is lit. - **Simulator input:** The panel sends touches and keys straight to the simulator, so drags, holds and edge swipes behave like a finger, and Escape, Delete and the arrow keys work. Home now responds right away, including on the iPhone Duo.

## Controller 1.0.51 (80)
- **Mac launch fix:** Fixed a crash on launch on earlier macOS 27.2 beta builds caused by weak-imported `Date` comparison operators in the macOS 27.2 SDK. - **iOS Simulator:** Finds Xcode when Command Line Tools is selected as the active developer directory, and displays the active screen on two-screen simulators. - **Antigravity:** Updated the bundled Antigravity ACP binary to 1.4.1 and preserved compaction status rows. - **Worktrees:** Excludes path-bound build directories when cloning worktrees and cleans up DerivedData for removed worktrees.
